label: Bible Study
prompt: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will _____ their sin no more.
verse: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
note: The new covenant's finale — a God who chooses not to bring our sins back up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine _____.
verse: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
note: God guides with His eye — and the next verse says don't be like the mule that needs a bit and bridle.

label: Sunday School
prompt: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, _____ I was blind, now I see.
verse: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
note: The healed man couldn't win a theology debate, but he had one unbeatable argument: 'whereas I was blind, now I see.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, _____ all things.
verse: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
note: Love's four 'all things' — and the last one, endurance, keeps going after the other three get tired.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no _____, the strife ceaseth.
verse: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
note: No wood, no fire; no 'talebearer,' no strife. Starve gossip of fuel and quarrels go out on their own.
